provenance.clerk_text: Filed 45 years of monthly soil_moisture (Root Zone Soil Wetness, fraction 0-1) for Madrid, Spain (Iberia), 1981-01 to 2025-12, averaged over 9 points. Source: NASA POWER Monthly & Annual API, accessed 2026-11-14.

verdict.label: inconclusive
verdict.reason: The test cannot tell this trend from noise (p = 0.0627), and the slope's interval, widened for autocorrelation, reaches past ±0.005 per decade, so a trend that size is not ruled out.
